mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant, bot_id, bot_secret, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_wecom_aibot_config ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant, bot_id, bot_secret, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM crm_wecom_aibot_config WHERE tenant = #{tenant} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_aibot_config (tenant, bot_id, bot_secret, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{botId}, #{botSecretEnc}, CASE WHEN #{enabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant) DO UPDATE SET bot_id = EXCLUDED.bot_id, bot_secret = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.bot_secret, crm_wecom_aibot_config.bot_secret), enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
